keyPoints: Dhatuen aam taur par electron tyagkar dhanaayan (cation) banati hain, jabki adhatuen electron lekar rinayan (anion) banati hain; dono milkar aayanik yogik banate hain.
Kriyashilata shreni me potassium sabse upar aur sona sabse neeche hai — upar wali dhatu neeche wali ko uske lavan vilayan se visthapit kar deti hai.
Dhatuon ka nishkarshan unki kriyashilata par nirbhar karta hai — kam kriyashil wali garm karke, beech wali apchayan se aur zyada kriyashil wali vidhyut apghatan se nikaali jaati hain.
Lohe me jang lagna, chandi ka kala padna aur taambe par hari parat jamna ksharan (corrosion) hai; yashad-lepan (galvanisation) aur rang-rogan ise rokte hain.
Mishrdhatu (alloy) do ya zyada dhatuon ka samgun mishran hai — peetal taamba-jasta ka aur steel loha-carbon ka mishrdhatu hai, jo shuddh dhatu se majboot hote hain.
Adhatuen aam taur par bhungur aur vidhyut ki kuchalak hoti hain, par graphite (carbon ka roop) bijli ka suchalak hai — ye mahatvapurna apvaad hai.
Aam galti: sabhi dhatuen kathor aur thos hoti hain ye manna; sodium-potassium itne naram hain ki chaku se kat jaate hain aur paara kamre ke taap par drav hai.
subject: Science
title: Dhatu aur Adhatu: Gun aur Nishkarshan
